name: @create-something/flue-service-agent
description: Flue pilot service-agent endpoint for Policy OS delivery workflows.

scripts.flue:evidence: ../../../scripts/ona-bootstrap-local.sh pnpm --dir packages/agents/flue-service-agent run build && node dist/lib/src/linear-evidence.js
scripts.flue:evidence:cloudflare: ../../../scripts/ona-bootstrap-local.sh pnpm --dir packages/agents/flue-service-agent run build && ../../../scripts/ona-bootstrap-local.sh pnpm --dir packages/agents/flue-service-agent run build:cloudflare && node dist/lib/src/linear-evidence.js --cloudflare
scripts.flue:history: ../../../scripts/ona-bootstrap-local.sh pnpm --dir packages/agents/flue-service-agent run build && node dist/lib/src/run-history.js --append
scripts.flue:history:cloudflare: ../../../scripts/ona-bootstrap-local.sh pnpm --dir packages/agents/flue-service-agent run build && ../../../scripts/ona-bootstrap-local.sh pnpm --dir packages/agents/flue-service-agent run build:cloudflare && node dist/lib/src/run-history.js --cloudflare --append
scripts.flue:resources:smoke: pnpm run flue:history:cloudflare && node dist/lib/src/mcp-resources.js --resource all --history-path .artifacts/flue-service-agent/run-history.jsonl
scripts.flue:run:golden: flue run service-delivery --target node --id runtime-routing-pi-flue --payload "$(cat fixtures/runtime-routing-pi-flue.json)"
scripts.flue:smoke:cloudflare: ../../../scripts/ona-bootstrap-local.sh pnpm --dir packages/agents/flue-service-agent run build && ../../../scripts/ona-bootstrap-local.sh pnpm --dir packages/agents/flue-service-agent run build:cloudflare && node dist/lib/src/smoke.js --cloudflare
